article_title: China's families are now supporting more old people than kids

tasks.prompt: What demographic change does the article describe?
options: China now has more dependent elderly people than children relative to its working-age population.
China's population of children doubled in one year.
Most elderly people in China have returned to full-time work.
China has ended all financial support for pensioners.
tasks.correct_answer: China now has more dependent elderly people than children relative to its working-age population.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לראשונה שיעור התלות של קשישים ביחס לאוכלוסייה בגיל העבודה גבוה משיעור הילדים.

tasks.prompt: What were the latest elderly and child dependency ratios?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שיעור התלות של הקשישים עלה ל־23%, לעומת 22% בקרב ילדים.

tasks.prompt: How many people in China are aged 65 and over?
options: About 53 million
About 213 million
More than 223 million
About 400 million
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הנתונים, יותר מ־223 מיליון בני אדם בסין הם בני 65 ומעלה.

tasks.prompt: What does the “silver economy” refer to in the article?
options: Government reserves held in precious metals
A programme that pays families to have children
Schools designed for smaller classes
Businesses and services aimed at older consumers
tasks.correct_answer: Businesses and services aimed at older consumers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: silver economy מתארת מוצרים ושירותים המיועדים לאוכלוסייה המבוגרת.

tasks.prompt: Which past policy contributed to China's ageing population?
options: The one-child policy in force from 1980 to 2015
A ban on urban employment
A policy requiring retirement at age 40
A programme that reduced life expectancy
tasks.correct_answer: The one-child policy in force from 1980 to 2015
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מדיניות הילד האחד צמצמה את מספר הצעירים שיכולים לתמוך במספר הולך וגדל של מבוגרים.

tasks.prompt: Why could the demographic shift weaken consumer spending?
options: Older people are legally prevented from shopping.
China has stopped producing consumer goods.
Families and the government may need to devote more resources to pensions, healthcare and care services.
Children now receive all public spending.
tasks.correct_answer: Families and the government may need to devote more resources to pensions, healthcare and care services.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר יותר משאבים מופנים לטיפול, בריאות ופנסיות, נשאר פחות כסף לצריכה אחרת ולצמיחה.

tasks.prompt: Give three factors that have contributed to China's low birth rate or ageing population.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה גורמים מדויקים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: The long-running one-child policy reduced the number of younger people.
Rapid urbanisation changed family patterns.
Rising living costs discourage larger families.
Changing gender roles affect fertility decisions.
Higher education levels have put pressure on fertility rates.
Longer life expectancy increases the elderly population.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the new demographic milestone and two likely effects in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את נתוני 23% ו־22% ולתאר שתי השפעות אפשריות על המשפחה, המדינה או הכלכלה.
expected_points: The elderly dependency ratio reached 23%, overtaking the child ratio of 22%.
China has more than 223 million people aged 65 and over and about 213 million children aged 14 or under.
Pension, healthcare and long-term care systems may face greater pressure.
Economic growth and household spending power may be limited.
The silver economy may create new opportunities.

tasks.prompt: Explain why the dependency ratio may give an incomplete picture of older people. Use evidence from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את מגבלות המדד באמצעות הטענה בדבר עצמאות מבוגרים ושיפורי הבריאות.
expected_points: The ratio automatically classifies people above a certain age as dependants.
Many older people may still be active, healthy or economically independent.
People entering old age may have higher incomes and stronger purchasing power than previous generations.
Healthcare improvements are not reflected in the simple ratio.
Experts warn that the measure can take agency away from older people.

tasks.prompt: Write a short policy recommendation responding to China's ageing population. Include one immediate pressure and one opportunity.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע המלצה מבוססת כתבה, להזכיר לחץ אחד והזדמנות אחת, ולשמור על ניסוח מאוזן.
expected_points: Addresses pressure on pensions, healthcare or long-term care.
Suggests targeted support for older people or families.
Recognises opportunities in products and services for older consumers.
Avoids treating every older person as helpless or dependent.
Uses a clear evidence-based tone.
